# requirement fixtures

- `basic.mmd` and `larger.mmd` are the examples in the Mermaid requirement
  diagram documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/requirementDiagram.html),
  MIT licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `legacy-sample.mmd` is the requirement sample shipped with mermaid-svg 0.7.0
  (`crates/nana-ui-runtime/tests/fixtures/mermaid/requirement.mmd`), MIT licensed.
- `styled-direction.mmd` and `cjk-long.mmd` are written for this crate:
  quoted names, direction, classes and styles, CJK and long text.
